description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerOptionSetDao interface, providing data access methods for CustomerOptionSet entities. It includes methods for fetching CustomerOptionSets by ID, option ID, option value ID, and listing CustomerOptionSets for a store with localization considerations.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDaoImpl
classes.description: Repository implementation class for CustomerOptionSet data access operations, extending generic DAO functionality and implementing CustomerOptionSetDao interface.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionSet entity by its unique identifier, performing multiple joins to fetch associated customer options and values.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific option ID within a given store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Fetches a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific option value ID within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all CustomerOptionSet entities for a given store, considering localization with language parameter.
